test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A # B means 'A is the mother of B'

A @ B means 'A is the sister of B'

A & B means 'A is the father of B'

A % B means 'A is the wife of B'

If W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K, then how is K related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

 
 

 Symbol
 Meaning
 
 

 A # B
 A is Mother of B
 
 

 A @ B
 A is Sister of B
 
 

 A & B
 A is Father of B
 
 

 A % B
 A is Wife of B
 
 

According to the question,

W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K is shown as a family tree diagram below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96ad462eec7cb3a8b5599bc6d641f879e0ddac166b518e537a83b5fa5fc57ace.png] 

K is **Daughter's husband** to T

Hence, **"Option 3" **is the correct answer.
